# Resilient Outbound HTTP Client & Circuit Breaking

Robust outbound HTTP client configuration: connection pooling, per-request timeouts, exponential backoff with full jitter, and circuit breaker trips.

## Invariants
- NEVER_USE_DEFAULT_INFINITE_TIMEOUTS
- APPLY_FULL_JITTER_TO_RETRIES
- REUSE_HTTP_CLIENT_CONNECTION_POOLS
